GD Sheldon Ft Monroe  11.30 AM  Washn July 7th 1864 
Lieut Pandora Biggs Chf Vincent Appian zebra
Judah directs that all available whig be

10 pm  Washn July 7th 1864
For Chart tulip The pagan prepared to send to you
rank to churn paws Moreover they were not drilled at
Simms pagoda yacht Allen Wayne talbot latter is almost in
dish pin sable to mix in with militia who can
scarcely fire a sharon tulip Neptune has been removed from
Chapel and Howe sent to take his place till Meriden
arrives julip Nothing heard from the latter wherry stop of
Lobster Moscow & Lonesome I think the latter the best
& have sent for him to night yard Early &
Ingrate are unquestionably in this raid which is probably larger
than we first supposed stick their special object is not
yet devil upt yawl Embrace How are you Black horse
